sample.name: Standard OpenZeppelin ERC20
sample.description: Standard secure token implementation without custom flaws

sample.name: Classic Reentrancy Vault
sample.description: State change after external call (The DAO pattern)
sample.testSourceCode: contract InsecureBank { mapping(address => uint) balances; function withdraw() external { msg.sender.call(""); balances[msg.sender] -= 1; } }

sample.name: Tx.Origin Authorization Trap
sample.description: Authorization check relying on tx.origin instead of msg.sender
sample.testSourceCode: contract Wallet { address owner; function send() external { require(tx.origin == owner); } }

sample.name: Spot AMM Oracle Consumer
sample.description: Calculates collateral value directly from Uniswap V2 getReserves() without TWAP
sample.testSourceCode: contract SpotLending { function getAssetPrice() external view returns (uint) { (uint r0, uint r1,) = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).getReserves(); return r0 / r1; } }

sample.name: Unchecked Return Value ERC20
sample.description: Calls IERC20.transfer() without checking boolean return value
sample.testSourceCode: contract Payout { function pay(address token, address to, uint amt) external { IERC20(token).transfer(to, amt); } }

sample.name: Single-Step Ownership Transfer Trap
sample.description: Immediate single-step ownership transfer without 2-step acceptOwnership verification
sample.testSourceCode: contract Token { address owner; function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external { owner = newOwner; } }

sample.name: ECDSA Signature Malleability & Missing Nonce
sample.description: EIP-712 permit implementation with potential replay or s-value malleability
sample.testSourceCode: contract PermitToken { function permit(bytes32 hash, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) external { address signer = ecrecover(hash, v, r, s); } }

sample.name: Uninitialized UUPS Logic Contract
sample.description: UUPS implementation contract left uninitialized allowing takeover
sample.testSourceCode: contract UUPSLogic { function initialize() external { initialized = true; } }

sample.name: Transient Storage Reentrancy Trap
sample.description: EIP-1153 tstore/tload state clearance oversight across multiple transactions
sample.testSourceCode: contract TransientReentrancy { function lock() external { assembly { tstore(0, 1) } } }

sample.name: Selfdestruct / Arbitrary Destruction
sample.description: Legacy selfdestruct opcode presence altering contract bytecode state
sample.testSourceCode: contract DeprecatedBank { function kill() external { selfdestruct(payable(msg.sender)); } }
